newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity Select Food fund manager resigns.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity Select Food fund manager resigns.

text.p: William Mankivsky, the manager of Fidelity Investments' Select Food and Agriculture Portfolio, has resigned to pursue other opportunities, the mutual fund company said Tuesday.
Beginning November 4, Mankivsky will join Harvard Management Company, which manages Harvard University's $8.0 billion endowment, and be involved in domestic equities, a spokesman for Harvard said.

Fidelity named Daniel Pickering as manager of Select Food and Agriculure, effective immediately. Stephen Binder succeeds Pickering as manager of Fidelity Select Natural Gas Portfolio, effective November 1.
Pickering will continue to manage Fidelity Select Energy Service Portfolio.

Deborah Wheeler was named portfolio manager of Fidelity Select Medical Delivery Portfolio, suceeding Binder. Wheeler previously was an equity analyst and has managed Fidelity Select Construction & Housing among other funds.
